description: This is a Java test class for the AnyKeyboardViewWithMiniKeyboard component, containing unit tests for popup behavior, long press handling, theme setting, and keyboard layout interactions within the keyboard view.

classes.name: AnyKeyboardViewWithMiniKeyboardTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of AnyKeyboardViewWithMiniKeyboard, including popup display, long press handling, theme changes, and interaction with keyboard keys.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects before each test.

methods.name: setCreatedKeyboardView
methods.description: Sets the created keyboard view for testing.

methods.name: createViewToTest
methods.description: Creates an instance of the view to be tested.

methods.name: testPopupShownListener
methods.description: Verifies that the popup shown listener is called appropriately when the popup is shown or dismissed.

methods.name: testShortPressWhenNoPrimaryKeyAndNoPopupItemsShouldNotOutput
methods.description: Ensures no output occurs when pressing a key with no primary code and no popup items.

methods.name: testShortPressWithLabelWhenNoPrimaryKeyAndNoPopupItemsShouldNotOutput
methods.description: Ensures no output occurs when pressing a labeled key with no primary code and no popup items.

methods.name: testShortPressWhenNoPrimaryKeyAndPopupCharactersShouldShowPopupWindow
methods.description: Checks that a popup window is shown when pressing a key with popup characters.

methods.name: testLongPressWhenNoPrimaryKeyButTextShouldOpenMiniKeyboard
methods.description: Verifies that a mini keyboard opens on long press when the key has associated text.

methods.name: testLongPressKeyWithPopupCharacters
methods.description: Tests that long pressing a key with popup characters shows the mini keyboard.

methods.name: testLongPressWithPopupDoesNotOutputPrimaryCode
methods.description: Ensures that long pressing a key with a popup does not output the primary code.

methods.name: testLongPressKeyWithoutAny
methods.description: Verifies behavior when long pressing a key with no popup or text.

methods.name: testSetsThemeWithMiniKeyboard
methods.description: Checks that setting a new theme dismisses the mini keyboard popup.

methods.name: testLongPressKeyWithPopupLayout
methods.description: Verifies that long pressing a key with a popup layout shows the mini keyboard with correct keys.

methods.name: testNonStickyPopupDismissedAfterUpEvent
methods.description: Ensures that non-sticky popups are dismissed after the up event.

methods.name: testStickyPopupStaysAroundAfterUpEvent
methods.description: Verifies that sticky popups remain visible after the up event until explicitly dismissed.

methods.name: testLongPressKeyPressStateWithLayout
methods.description: Checks the visual pressed state of a key during long press with layout.

methods.name: testLongPressKeyPressStateWithPopupCharacters
methods.description: Checks the pressed state during long press with popup characters.
